prompts: Create a production 2D sprite animation atlas using the attached painted chibi blue-and-gold Three Kingdoms soldier as the exact character/style reference. New animation drawings, not a concept poster. Same face, head/body proportions, armor and equipment throughout. Crisp bold outline, simple readable shading suited to small battlefield units about 100-140 pixels tall. Uniform camera, size, center and ground baseline in every cell. Generous EMPTY 15% margin in EACH cell, absolutely no crossing cell edges, no captions, no frame numbers, no gridlines, no scenery, no cast shadow. Genuinely transparent alpha background, not a painted checkerboard. Each frame is a DISTINCT closely spaced intermediate pose in chronological row-major order. No motion blur, no crossfading, no duplicated frames. EXACTLY SIXTEEN frames arranged EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows in a square 2048x2048 atlas. One blue armored rider on the SAME brown horse, lance angled forward toward the right, same side/three-quarter view as reference. A smooth seamless full horse gallop cycle in place. Draw all 16 consecutive phases of ONE stride, NOT four repeated four-frame loops: 1 full extended suspension, 2 lowering forelegs, 3 leading forehoof contacts, 4 other forehoof contacts, 5 weight travels onto forelegs, 6 rear legs swing under belly, 7 collected suspension, 8 rearlegs begin reaching down, 9 rearhooves contact, 10 weight on hindquarters, 11 rearlegs press backward, 12 hindleg push-off, 13 forelegs reach forward, 14 body rises into extension, 15 almost full extended suspension, 16 transition smoothly toward frame1. Torso and rider bounce only very subtly, legs articulate clearly at knees/hocks, consistent correct four-leg anatomy. Horse body remains at the same x coordinate. Plume and tail flow smoothly. Maintain same horse body length in every cell.
